name: Therzok
summary: In Orgrimmar, Therzok awaits a promising rogue sent from Durotar. Kaplak has seen your skill in violence and stealth, and sends you to the Cleft of Shadow to meet a Shattered Hand operative.

sections.title: A Whispered Summons
sections.body: The new Horde honors Thrall, yet not all its servants fight openly beneath his banner. Word reaches Orgrimmar of a fighter skilled in violence and stealth, one willing to bend the rules of open warfare. The underground guild takes notice.

sections.title: Into the Cleft of Shadow
sections.body: Kaplak sends you beneath Orgrimmar's red stone cliffs to the Cleft of Shadow. Therzok waits there, hidden from the city's grunts. Lone cutpurses and ambushers are brought into the Shattered Hand, the Horde's covert network of daggers in the dark.

faq.answer: In Orgrimmar's Cleft of Shadow, Therzok serves the Shattered Hand. He meets promising young rogues from Durotar's training grounds and brings them into the guild's service.

faq.q: Why does Kaplak send me to him?
faq.answer: Kaplak has seen your skill in combat and your talent for stealth and subterfuge. Knowing the Shattered Hand seeks capable scoundrels, he sends you to Therzok with a request to recruit you.

faq.q: What is the Shattered Hand in Orgrimmar?
faq.answer: In Orgrimmar, the Shattered Hand is a secret guild of assassins, spies, and thieves who serve the Horde. They undertake difficult work that Thrall's honorable warriors cannot perform openly.

faq.q: Where is the Cleft of Shadow located?
faq.answer: The Cleft of Shadow is a cavern beneath central Orgrimmar. Dark passages descend to it from the Valley of Strength and the Drag. It shelters the city's warlocks and rogues from public scrutiny.
After you greet Therzok, he explains the duties of Shattered Hand service. Then he assigns work to test your capability, stealth, and loyalty to the network.
No. Only rogues receive this summons after gaining a certain amount of experience. It marks their passage from local skirmishes into the Horde's intelligence network.

angles.text: As a rogue, this summons brings you into the Shattered Hand. Your solitary work in Durotar now connects to the Horde's organized spy network.
As a member of the Horde, you know Thrall preaches honor and the warrior spirit. Therzok's network shows the Horde also depends on unseen blades and secret gatherers of intelligence.
